title: A trouble raise refuses a detail that is not a mapping
intention: BaseDiagnostic.raise_trouble refuses, with TroubleRaiseRefused naming the type, a detail that is neither None nor a dict, so a malformed raise is loud at its caller and never reaches the drain.
why: Measured 2026-10-11 by cc0: the emission /home/akien/.cairn/logs/harbor_master/0/20261009.000059.516741.harbor_master.raise_trouble.json (pointer no-door-retires-a-proved-tickets-watch-as-superseded, raised by hand 2026-10-09) carries values.detail as a STRING. Every TroubleShim.drain since refuses it: "TypeError: 'str' object is not a mapping" at cairn/devices/trouble/shim.py _fold ({**(values.get('detail') or {}), ...}). The trouble never landed in the store, and the drain's break holds harbor_master's raise watermark at that file, so the next harbor_master raise would never land either (0 behind it today). Cause upstream: BaseDiagnostic.raise_trouble (cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py) types detail as dict but writes whatever it is handed.
traces_to: Law 7 (an error is loud at its diagnostic surface: the caller), and CP6 (a malformed alarm must not silence the lane behind it).
how: cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py raise_trouble only: after the why check, `if detail is not None and not isinstance(detail, dict): raise TroubleRaiseRefused(f"a trouble's detail is a mapping (this occurrence's own data, keyed); got {type(detail).__name__}")`. Nothing is emitted on refusal.
falsifier: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_raise_detail_is_a_mapping.py under PROVES {'93a9cc0f7677': {'1','2'}}, with a scratch log home: (1) raise_trouble('x', why='w', detail='text') raises TroubleRaiseRefused naming 'str' and writes no emission file; (2) detail=None and detail={'a':1} still emit. Hollow: the old raise_trouble reds 1 (it writes the file).
